rationale: Two exact shared SQL mutations for publisher coupon issuance and price-change outbox events were removed from the promotions module and placed in an authenticated, typed, private QA owner. The owner checks current campaign, membership, product associations, coupon limits and independently derives the published promotion price; rejects coupon-code reassignment; and uses replay-safe deterministic events. Coupon mutation and the event are committed in one primary D1 transaction. No production legal-owner activation, paid settlement or rollback certification.

files.review: Two protected SQL statements physically retired from the public module and bound to the private owner; zero surviving protected promotions statements.
